source: EI release 2576d0f3 (iriv24/pokeemerald-expansion, release branch; checked out at .tmp/ei-release): src/data/moves_info.h (effect, additionalEffects with chance 0/100 = guaranteed, self), src/battle_util.c (CanBe* status checks, chance == 0 guaranteed), src/battle_script_commands.c (stat-drop blockers, Safeguard), include/config/battle.h (all B_ switches GEN_LATEST, B_USE_FROSTBITE TRUE).
notes: Sand Attack: lowers the target's Attack -1, not Accuracy (src/data/moves_info.h:796 EFFECT_ATTACK_DOWN)
Charge Beam: Sp. Atk +1 on the user with chance 100, not 70 (src/data/moves_info.h:11276 additionalEffects SP_ATK_PLUS_1 self chance 100)
Flash: a Special move (power 60) whose Attack -1 is a 50% secondary; no guaranteed effect, so the status Acc -1 of the table is gone (src/data/moves_info.h:3757)
Mud-Slap: no accuracy drop at all, no additionalEffects (src/data/moves_info.h:4780; the description still says it reduces accuracy: the code wins)
Zippy Zap: no Evasion +1 on the user (src/data/moves_info.h:16786, no additionalEffects)
Ice Hammer: no Speed -1 on the user (src/data/moves_info.h:15609, no additionalEffects)
Scale Shot: no Defense -1 / Speed +1 (EFFECT_MULTI_HIT with no additionalEffects) (src/data/moves_info.h:18041)
Bitter Malice: no guaranteed Attack -1; the only effect is a 30% freeze / frostbite (src/data/moves_info.h:19044)

Diamond Storm (not overridden): Defense +2 on the user is a 50% self effect (src/data/moves_info.h:14692, additionalEffects DEF_PLUS_2 self chance 50); the shared table has it as a 50% self part, never applied
Freezy Frost: Haze after the hit, chance 100: both sides' stat changes removed (src/data/moves_info.h:17023 MOVE_EFFECT_HAZE)
Life Dew: EFFECT_JUNGLE_HEALING, the same effect as Jungle Healing: cures the user's status (src/data/moves_info.h:17846, ALL_BATTLERS; singles: the user). The table had no effect

Magnetic Flux (not overridden): Def +1 and SpD +1 only when the user has the Plus or Minus ability (data/battle_scripts_1.s BattleScript_EffectMagneticFlux, src/data/moves_info.h:14965). The record has no conditions; left none
Alluring Voice (not overridden): confusion at chance 100 only if the target raised a stat this turn (src/data/moves_info.h:20605, onlyIfTargetRaisedStats). Not modelled: no record change
Power Split, Guard Split, Speed Swap: average or swap raw stats, not stage changes; not modelled (src/data/moves_info.h, EFFECT_POWER_SPLIT / GUARD_SPLIT / SPEED_SWAP)

Blockers: every row matches EI's GEN_LATEST switches (include/config/battle.h), so no rules were set. Frostbite: EI's frz is Frostbite (B_USE_FROSTBITE TRUE); Sun does not stop it (CanGetFrostbite, src/battle_util.c:6718), and the table has no Sun rule for frz, which is right

Blockers, not expressible in rules: EI's accuracy protection is Keen Eye and Mind's Eye only (src/battle_script_commands.c:5620, 11959); Illuminate blocks nothing in battle (it is only in the damage calc and the wild encounter code). The table's keen-eye row also lists Illuminate for gen 9, so a gen 9 Illuminate target shows Acc drops as Fails. Needs a template change (split the row); not fixed here
Blockers, doubles only: Pastel Veil, Sweet Veil and Flower Veil protect allies too (IsAbilityOnSide, src/battle_util.c:6662 and 6684). The table checks the target only; singles unaffected
unsourced: Magnetic Flux: conditional on the user's Plus / Minus ability; the record has no conditions (left none)
Alluring Voice: confusion only when the target raised a stat; not modelled (left as the table has it)
